categories.name: Wabash Flats Issue
categories.description: Report potholes, damaged pavement, roadkill on public streets or alleys, fallen road debris, or missed trash collection.

questions.label: Issue type
questions.placeholder: e.g. pothole, roadkill removal, fallen debris, missed trash collection

questions.label: Location and description
questions.placeholder: A dead animal in the northbound lane needs to be removed.

categories.name: Wabash River Commons Issue
categories.description: Wabash River Commons is a private community. Report road and property issues directly to its management team using the contact details below.

categories.name: Parks & Recreation Facilities (Damage, Vandalism, Playgrounds)
categories.description: Report damaged playground equipment or park shelters, overflowing trash, or vandalism at Maconaquah Park and other municipal facilities.

questions.label: Park Issue Type
options: Damaged, Vandalized, or Unsanitary Park Restroom
Vandalism or Graffiti on Park Structure
Fallen Tree Branch on Park Trail or Play Area

questions.label: Park / Facility Name
questions.placeholder: e.g. Maconaquah Park, Miami's Fort, Riverwalk, Municipal Golf Course

questions.label: Specific Location & Context
questions.placeholder: Park and exact location within it; identify the equipment or fixture and describe the damage or sanitation issue.

categories.name: Street Surface & Debris (Potholes, Obstructions, Missed Collection)
categories.description: Report potholes, asphalt damage, fallen road debris, or missed residential trash, recycling, and yard-waste collection.

questions.label: Type of Roadway / Surface Hazard
options: Missed Trash, Recycling, or Yard Waste Collection

questions.label: Traffic / Collection Impact
options: Partially - Drivers must slow down or swerve
Completely - Lane or alley completely blocked
Collection missed - Cart was out before the route

questions.label: Location, Road Hazard, or Collection Details
questions.placeholder: Street address or cross streets; lane and pothole size, debris details, or waste type and whether the cart was out by 6:00 AM.

categories.name: Traffic Signals, Signs & Road Control Devices
categories.description: Report dark or malfunctioning traffic signals, knocked-down stop or yield signs, missing or damaged street-name signs, or damaged signal poles.

questions.label: Traffic Infrastructure Issue
options: Damaged or Knocked-Down Stop / Yield Sign
Missing / Damaged / Vandalized Street Name or Traffic Sign
Damaged Traffic Signal Pole / Push Button

questions.label: Intersection or Location Details
questions.placeholder: Exact intersection, sign or signal type, and whether it is missing, down, obscured, dark, or flashing. For an immediate traffic danger, call 911.

keywords: damaged or knocked-down stop / yield sign

categories.name: Hazardous Trees, Foliage & Sign Visibility Obstructions
categories.department: Peru Street Department, Utility Line Trimming, and Parks Department
categories.description: Report overgrown branches blocking stop signs or sightlines, fallen limbs blocking roads, or tree limbs threatening power or telecom wires.

questions.label: Foliage / Tree Safety Hazard
options: Overgrown Tree / Hedge Obscuring Stop Sign or Intersection View
Low-Hanging Limbs Over a Roadway or Public Sidewalk
Fallen Tree Branch Blocking Roadway / Alley / Sidewalk
Tree Limb Resting on Wires (Power / Telecom)
Dead or Leaning Municipal Tree Posing Immediate Fall Risk

questions.label: Is the tree touching power or utility lines?
options: Yes - Touching or tangled in electrical / telecom lines

questions.label: Specific Location & Visual Description
questions.placeholder: Address and whether the tree is in the public right-of-way; note vehicle or pedestrian clearance and any blocked sidewalk. Stay clear of limbs touching wires.

categories.name: Clogged Storm Drains & Flooding
categories.description: Report clogged storm drain catch basins, standing water at the Broadway Tunnel underpass, or localized street flooding.

questions.label: Drainage / Flooding Problem
options: Railroad Underpass Flooded / Standing Water (Broadway Tunnel)
Clogged Storm Drain Inlet / Leaf & Trash Accumulation
Creek Bank Erosion / Riverbank / Ditch Washout
Stormwater Contamination / Illegal Dumping in Drain

questions.label: Specific Location & Water Depth Details
questions.placeholder: Exact street/intersection, water depth and flow, whether the grate is broken or blocked, and any roadway or property impact.

categories.name: Water Main Leaks, Running Water & Sewage Odors
categories.department: Peru Utilities - Division of Water Management
categories.description: Report gushing water leaks, water bubbling from a street or curb, low pressure, discolored water, raw sewage backups, or sewage odors.

questions.label: Water / Sewer Issue Type
options: Water Main Leak / Clean Water Bubbling or Flowing from Ground
Fire Hydrant Damaged, Leaking, or Struck
Water Bubbling Up From Curb / Sidewalk
Sewage Odor / Raw Sewer Line Backup

questions.label: Report Urgency
options: Active Water Main Break / Property Threat
Emergency / Active Main Break or Property Threat (call Peru Utilities at 765-473-6681)

questions.label: Location & Observed Conditions
questions.placeholder: Exact address or intersection, amount and direction of water flow, hydrant condition, and any roadway or property impact. For urgent issues, call Peru Utilities at 765-473-6681.

categories.name: Natural Gas Smell or Pipeline Hazard (NIPSCO)
categories.description: Report suspected natural gas leaks or rotten-egg odors. If you smell gas inside or near a building, leave immediately and call 911 from a safe location. For an outdoor leak, call NIPSCO at (800) 634-3524.

questions.label: Location & Details
questions.placeholder: From a safe location, give the address and describe the odor, hissing, or damaged line. Do not operate switches or start vehicles. If gas is inside or near a building, leave and call 911; for an outdoor leak, call NIPSCO at (800) 634-3524.

categories.name: Animal Care & Control (Loose, Injured, or Stray Animals)
categories.department: Peru Animal Care & Control (Greg Douglass, Officer)
categories.description: Report loose or aggressive dogs, deceased animals on roadways, and animal-control concerns. For a loose dog, City guidance says to call 24/7 Dispatch at (765) 473-5522.

questions.label: Type of Animal Issue
options: Stray or Aggressive Dog / Loose Dog in Traffic
Dead Animal on a Public Roadway or Right-of-Way

questions.label: Animal Description & Last Known Location
questions.placeholder: For a loose dog, call Dispatch at (765) 473-5522. Otherwise give the address or cross streets, animal type, condition, and whether it is in a lane or on the shoulder. Do not approach an aggressive animal.

keywords: stray or aggressive dog / loose dog in traffic

categories.name: Power Outages and Streetlight Issues
categories.department: Peru Utilities Line Department (Michael Biesenbach, T&D Supt)
categories.description: Report streetlight outages, flickering lights, lights that remain on during the day, and damaged transformers. For downed wires, sparks, or smoke, stay at least 30 feet away and call 911.

questions.label: Electrical Issue
options: Streetlight Out, Flickering, or Remaining On During Daylight
Damaged Transformer or Open Pad-Mount Cabinet
Downed Power Line / Electrical Sparking (call 911; stay at least 30 feet away)

questions.label: Pole Tag Number or Nearest Address
questions.placeholder: e.g. Metal tag number on pole or nearest street address

questions.label: Additional Context
questions.placeholder: Exact address or cross street, pole tag number, and whether the light is dark, flickering, or on during daylight. For downed wires, sparks, or smoke, stay at least 30 feet away and call 911.

categories.name: Blocked Railroad Crossing (Stopped Trains)
categories.description: Report a stopped train using the Federal Railroad Administration's blocked-crossing form. For immediate danger at a crossing, call Miami County Central Dispatch at (765) 473-5522. Call 911 if a person or vehicle is on the tracks or a crossing gate is malfunctioning.

questions.label: How long has the crossing been blocked?
Train Details / Engine Number (if visible)
questions.placeholder: Describe the crossing and train location. Include the engine number if visible. For a person or vehicle on the tracks, or a malfunctioning gate, call 911.

categories.name: High Grass, Blight, Private Vehicles & Code Violations
categories.department: Building and Zoning Department (Bruce Carson, Commissioner; Bill Sheets, Code Enforcement)
categories.description: Report grass taller than 8 inches, junk or blight in yards, abandoned or inoperable vehicles, or unsafe structures.

questions.label: Code Violation Category
options: Trash, Junk, or Blight in Yard or Alley
Inoperable / Unregistered Vehicle on Private Property
Blighted, Unsafe, or Unsecured Vacant Building

questions.label: Specific Description of Violation
questions.placeholder: Property address, location on the lot, and details of the condition; for a vehicle, include make, model, color, and whether it is on private property or a public street.

categories.name: Abandoned Vehicles & Vandalism on Public Property
categories.department: Peru Police Department / Miami County Central Dispatch
categories.description: Report vehicles abandoned on public streets for more than 72 hours, or graffiti and vandalism on public property. Email mayorsadmin@cityofperu.org or call Dispatch at (765) 473-5522. Call 911 for an immediate threat or active incident.

questions.label: Public-Space Police Issue
options: Abandoned Vehicle on Public Street (over 72 hours)
Graffiti or Vandalism on Public Property or a Bridge

questions.label: Vehicle Details (if applicable)
questions.placeholder: For a vehicle: make, model, color, plate state/number, exact location, and how long it has been parked.

questions.label: Exact Location and Incident Details
questions.placeholder: Street address or cross streets; for vandalism, identify the public structure and whether it is ongoing. Call 911 for an immediate threat.

categories.name: Sidewalks, Trip Hazards & ADA Curb Aprons
categories.description: Report buckled or cracked sidewalks, severe tripping hazards, sunken curb ramps, or blocked public walkways.

questions.label: Walkway Hazard
options: Tree Root Buckled Sidewalk / Severe Lipping Hazard
Damaged ADA Curb Ramp / Tactile Mat

questions.label: Location & Context
questions.placeholder: Street address, height of the raised edge or size of the missing section, and whether the sidewalk is blocked or difficult to pass.

questions.placeholder: e.g. Deep pothole on US 31 northbound ramp at SR 19 exit.
